paper.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.

one_sentence.text: RoleFlow 针对固定协作结构和结构编辑信用分配困难，通过反馈驱动的原子编辑、按需角色合成及 SECPO 训练适应角色链；作者报告七基准平均67.1分，比 W4S 高4.7分。

evidence.quote: A trainable Global Router (GR) constructs task-specific role chains and refines them through atomic structural edits, while synthesizing specialized roles on demand.
We propose SECPO , a structure-aware policy optimization method that estimates the counterfactual contribution of individual structural edits and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens.
RoleFlow achieves the highest average score of 67.1 across seven benchmarks, outperforming the strongest competing multi-agent system, W4S, by 4.7 points and ranking first on five benchmarks.

research_problem.text: 作者指出，预定义协作结构限制任务适应性；动态编排采用的轨迹级奖励难以识别单次结构修改的贡献。

evidence.quote: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes.

method_steps.text: GR 构建初始角色链，冻结执行器依次执行，各角色接收任务及此前输出；独立任务验证器返回判决、分数和缺陷，暂存记忆保存轨迹与验证历史。

evidence.quote: The GR first writes a plan that decomposes the task and names the roles of \mathrm{RFC}_{0} .
A frozen executor LLM runs these roles sequentially, with each role receiving the task and the outputs of preceding roles.

A separate task validator V assesses the output and trace, returning a pass/reject indicator h_{t}\in\{0,1\} , score s_{t} , and deficit description d_{t} . Scratch memory \sigma_{t} stores the execution traces and validation history.

method_steps.text: 验证拒绝后，每轮至多进行一次增加、删除、替换、位置交换或空编辑；缺失角色按需合成，有缺陷却提出空编辑时触发缺陷驱动合成。验证通过或达到轮数上限即停止。

evidence.quote: \textsc{Add}(\rho) (insert \rho before the final role), \textsc{Prune}(\rho) (remove \rho ), \textsc{Swap}(\rho,\rho^{\prime}) (replace \rho by \rho^{\prime} in place), \textsc{Reroute}(p,q) (exchange the roles at positions p and q ), and the null edit
An edit is proposed only after rejection, and each cycle applies at most one edit.
A role the GR names but \mathcal{R}_{0} lacks is synthesized by the LibraryExpander, and a null edit under a deficit triggers deficit-driven synthesis.
The edited chain is then executed in the next cycle, and the process stops upon validation success or after T_{\max} adaptation cycles

method_steps.text: 训练时，SECPO 在同一链状态比较编辑与不编辑的奖励；差值超过阈值才提交编辑。局部优势额外分配到编辑 token，与组相对优势共同训练 GR；未提交编辑的反事实对仍参与更新。

Otherwise, the chain remains unchanged. Importantly, the counterfactual pair contributes to the policy update even when the candidate edit is not committed.

author_contributions.text: 作者自述提出 RoleFlow，以反馈驱动的原子结构编辑和按需专家角色合成实现协作结构适应。

evidence.quote: We introduce RoleFlow , a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that enables feedback-driven structural adaptation through atomic edits and on-demand specialist synthesis.

author_contributions.text: 作者自述提出 SECPO，估计单次结构编辑的反事实贡献，并将信用定向分配给编辑相关 token；这不构成对首创性的独立确认。

evidence.quote: We propose SECPO , a structure-aware policy optimization method that estimates the counterfactual contribution of individual structural edits and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens.

reported_comparisons.text: 作者报告 RoleFlow 七基准平均分领先 W4S 4.7分；表中直接提示 Claude-Haiku-4.5 的数学和两个代码基准得分均高于 RoleFlow。

evidence.quote: RoleFlow achieves the highest average score of 67.1 across seven benchmarks, outperforming the strongest competing multi-agent system, W4S, by 4.7 points and ranking first on five benchmarks.

reported_comparisons.text: 以 GR 最常用的固定链替代 GR，HotpotQA 为45.7 F1，完整系统为55.6。表2说明 T_max=1 仍允许一次编辑，因此不能将该配置称为完全禁用适应。

evidence.quote: Replacing the GR with its most frequent fixed chain yields 45.7 F1 on HotpotQA, essentially the direct executor’s 45.6, versus 55.6 for RoleFlow.
T_{\max} : adaptation cycles allowed after cycle 0 (3 in RoleFlow; 1 allows a single edit).

reported_comparisons.text: SECPO 比 GRPO 在三个 QA 基准分别提高2.1、2.5、2.6 F1，但 MBPP 略低、HumanEval 持平；每训练题实际链执行均值由9.1增至13.5。

evidence.quote: Replacing SECPO with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) lowers mean F1 by 2.1, 2.5, and 2.6 points on HotpotQA, 2Wiki, and MuSiQue, respectively (Table 2 ).
The advantage is not universal: SECPO slightly trails GRPO on MBPP and ties it on HumanEval, where validation triggers fewer corrective edits.
This comes at a cost: realized chain executions rise from 9.1 to 13.5 per training question relative to standard GRPO.

experiments.text: 七基准主实验报告三次训练运行的均值与标准差；数学采用多候选投票及无严格多数时的模型选择，代码采用多候选测试筛选。

evidence.quote: HotpotQA 2Wiki OOD MuSiQue OOD MATH-500 MBPP HumanEval OOD WebShop Avg.
We report F1 for QA, accuracy for MATH-500, Pass@1 for MBPP and HumanEval, and the WebShop score. Results are means and standard deviations over three training runs.
We train the GR with SECPO using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in verl ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs; roles are executed by gpt-4o-mini.
RoleFlow achieves the highest average score of 67.1 across seven benchmarks, outperforming the strongest competing multi-agent system, W4S, by 4.7 points

One chain answers each QA question. On MATH-500 we sample twenty chains per problem and take the majority answer. When no answer wins more than half of the votes, one call of the executor LLM, which does not see the reference answer, picks one of the candidate answers.

On MBPP and HumanEval we sample ten chains per problem and submit one program. We pick the program that passes the most public example tests and, among those, the most unit tests that the executor LLM writes from the task statement

experiments.task: 多跳问答、数学推理、代码生成、Web 交互，共七个基准
experiments.baseline: W4S（作者称最强竞争多智能体系统）
experiments.metric: QA：F1；MATH-500：准确率；MBPP/HumanEval：Pass@1；WebShop：任务分数；七项平均分
experiments.resource_conditions: 训练使用4张 NVIDIA H200，运行三次；QA 每题一条链；数学每题20条链，严格多数优先，否则由执行器选择候选；代码每题10条链，测试筛选后提交一个程序。

experiments.task: HotpotQA 训练及效率比较；HotpotQA、2Wiki、MuSiQue 测试
experiments.baseline: 标准 GRPO、增加优化更新的 GRPO、增加 rollout 的 GRPO、COMA-Operator

experiments.result: SECPO 比标准 GRPO 分别高2.1、2.5、2.6 F1；增加 GRPO 预算最多提高1.0 F1；COMA-Operator 为55.6/41.4/36.6，SECPO 为55.6/43.5/42.1。
experiments.resource_conditions: 标准 GRPO：4.26M token、2.6 GPU-h、每题9.1次链执行；增加更新：7.33M token、3.4 GPU-h；增加 rollout：7.55M token、3.5 GPU-h；SECPO：5.07M token、3.7 GPU-h、每题13.5次链执行。

experiments.text: 跨执行器实验报告，以 gpt-4o-mini 训练的 GR 无需重训即可改善所评估执行器；具体增益基线在提供文本中未明确。

evidence.quote: Figure 6 shows that the GR trained with gpt-4o-mini improves all evaluated executors without retraining. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct gains 11.7 and 16.0 Pass@1 on MBPP and HumanEval, compared with 5.3 and 7.4 for gpt-4o-mini.

experiments.model: 以 gpt-4o-mini 为执行器训练的 GR；测试执行器包括 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gpt-4o-mini
experiments.result: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 分别提高11.7、16.0点；gpt-4o-mini 分别提高5.3、7.4点。
experiments.resource_conditions: 更换执行器后不重新训练 GR；完整预算未在提供文本中给出。

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，新领域必须提供逐轮判决与缺陷反馈的验证器；推理成本高于免训练流水线，SECPO 训练每次编辑额外执行一条链。

evidence.quote: RoleFlow requires a task validator that returns a pass or reject verdict and a deficit for every cycle, so a new domain needs such a check before the GR can be trained or run. Inference costs more than training-free pipelines and SECPO training executes one additional chain per edit.

limitations.text: 作者承认，多编辑训练变体仍按每轮单编辑测试，存在训练与测试不匹配；该消融支持单编辑配置，但不能隔离其机制贡献。

evidence.quote: Since these variants are evaluated with one edit per cycle, train–test mismatch also contributes to the comparison; the evidence supports the single-edit configuration without isolating that mechanism.

limitations.text: 作者将结构修订相对额外采样的质量与成本优势限定于所测设置，明确不据此声称普遍降低计算量。

evidence.quote: Under this setting, investing inference in revising collaboration yields a more favorable quality–cost trade-off than sampling additional answers; it does not imply universally lower compute.

roles.text: 角色由名称、系统提示词和能力标签定义，同一冻结执行器依次实现角色；默认链以 Planner 开始、Validator 结束。

evidence.quote: Each role \rho specifies a name, a system prompt, and capability tags.
A frozen executor LLM runs these roles sequentially, with each role receiving the task and the outputs of preceding roles. By default, the chain begins with a Planner and ends with a Validator.

coordination.text: GR 依据验证反馈选择并修订角色链；LibraryExpander 根据角色名、任务和当前缺陷合成缺失角色规格。

evidence.quote: Its Global Router (GR) selects and revises a chain of specialized roles using validation feedback.
If the GR names a role absent from \mathcal{R} , a LibraryExpander synthesizes its specification from the role name, task, and current deficit.

communication.text: 每个角色对应一次执行器调用，角色提示词作为系统消息，任务及此前角色输出组成用户消息。

evidence.quote: The executor LLM implements each role with one call. The system message is the role’s system prompt, and the user message is assembled as follows from the task and the outputs of the earlier roles.

shared_memory.text: 任务暂存记忆保存执行轨迹与验证历史；训练共享角色库保存经回报门控接纳的角色规格，供后续训练步骤使用。

evidence.quote: Scratch memory \sigma_{t} stores the execution traces and validation history.
After each training step, a return gate determines which synthesized role specifications enter the shared library.
The shared library is then available to subsequent training steps.

scheduling.text: 角色顺序执行，验证拒绝后才提出编辑，每轮至多一次；推理首次接受即停止，最多执行1+T_max次链。

evidence.quote: A frozen executor LLM runs these roles sequentially, with each role receiving the task and the outputs of preceding roles.
An edit is proposed only after rejection, and each cycle applies at most one edit.
The loop ends at the first accepted output or after T_{\max} adaptation cycles, so a chain is executed at most 1+T_{\max} times, once per cycle.

changed_object.text: 任务内改变角色链并合成角色规格；训练时更新 GR 全部参数，执行器保持冻结。

evidence.quote: A trainable Global Router (GR) constructs task-specific role chains and refines them through atomic structural edits, while synthesizing specialized roles on demand.
We train the GR with SECPO using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as the backbone in verl ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) , updating all parameters
The executor remains frozen; only the GR is trained.

feedback.text: 独立于链末 Validator 角色的任务验证器返回通过/拒绝、分数及固定类别缺陷；缺陷驱动修改，判决与分数构成周期奖励。

evidence.quote: In every domain the validator V returns the verdict h_{t} , the score s_{t} and a deficit d_{t} from a fixed set of categories (§ 3.1 ). It is separate from the Validator role.
After each rejected output, it uses the deficit d_{t} and accumulated memory \sigma_{t} to propose one structural edit.
The cycle reward is R(y_{t})=h_{t}+\lambda_{s}s_{t}

update_method.text: SECPO 以同状态编辑和不编辑的奖励差形成局部优势，加权叠加到编辑 token 的组相对优势上，并采用 PPO 裁剪目标与 KL 正则训练 GR。

evidence.quote: Every plan token receives the group-relative advantage A^{\mathrm{GRPO}}_{\ell} , and the single-edit advantage A^{(t)}_{i} is added with weight \lambda on the edit span \mathcal{E}^{(i)}_{t} .
while retaining GRPO’s critic-free group of K rollouts ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and PPO’s clipped surrogate with KL regularization ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) .

stage.text: 训练阶段更新 GR 并执行反事实重评；推理阶段 GR 参数固定，仅进行任务内角色链适应及角色合成。

evidence.quote: updates the GR with the SECPO loss (Eq. 5 ) and admits synthesized roles through the return gate (Eq. 6 ).
At inference the GR keeps its trained parameters \theta^{*} , and the role library holds the seed roles of the domain, written \mathcal{R}_{0} .
A role the GR names but \mathcal{R}_{0} lacks is synthesized by the LibraryExpander, and a null edit under a deficit triggers deficit-driven synthesis.
The counterfactual re-execution of § 3.3 serves training.

retention.text: 新角色先进入任务 rollout 临时覆盖层；训练中回报超过组内首个参考 rollout 才跨步骤保留。推理每题从领域种子库开始，不加载训练增长库，因此推理合成角色不跨题持续积累。

evidence.quote: The new role is stored in rollout i ’s temporary overlay \hat{\mathcal{R}}^{(i)}

A synthesized role \hat{\rho} from rollout i is admitted only if its rollout return exceeds that of reference rollout \tau_{\mathrm{ref}}^{(i)} , defined as the first rollout in its block of K within the training batch
The shared library is then available to subsequent training steps.
At inference, each task starts with the domain’s seed library rather than the library grown during training, and the required specialists are synthesized for that task.

held_out_validation.text: 推理设置依据与训练、测试均不重叠的留出数据选择；2Wiki、MuSiQue、HumanEval 用于 OOD 测试，不在其上搜索、训练或调参。

evidence.quote: We choose the inference settings of Appendix A.3 on held-out data that overlaps neither the training nor the test sets.
2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue and HumanEval are out-of-distribution benchmarks.
No method searches, trains or tunes on these three benchmarks. Each keeps what it obtained on HotpotQA or MBPP

system_insights: 系统分析：应区分训练中的参数学习与推理中的结构适应；推理 GR 参数固定，不能将任务内编辑解释为在线参数更新。依据 b00074：“At inference the GR keeps its trained parameters”。

open_questions: 系统分析问题：严格匹配 token、调用数或费用后，结构适应相对单智能体多次采样的优势能否跨领域保持？b00062 的结论限定为：“Under this setting”。

系统分析问题：如何区分结构编辑收益与整链重新执行带来的采样收益？b00027 的比较方式为：“SECPO executes the chain with the candidate edit”，并与不编辑执行结果比较。

RoleFlow requires a task validator that returns a pass or reject verdict and a deficit for every cycle, so a new domain needs such a check before the GR can be trained or run. Inference costs more than training-free pipelines and SECPO training executes one additional chain per edit.

Each role \rho specifies a name, a system prompt, and capability tags.
A frozen executor LLM runs these roles sequentially, with each role receiving the task and the outputs of preceding roles. By default, the chain begins with a Planner and ends with a Validator.
Its Global Router (GR) selects and revises a chain of specialized roles using validation feedback.
If the GR names a role absent from \mathcal{R} , a LibraryExpander synthesizes its specification from the role name, task, and current deficit.
The executor LLM implements each role with one call. The system message is the role’s system prompt, and the user message is assembled as follows from the task and the outputs of the earlier roles.
Scratch memory \sigma_{t} stores the execution traces and validation history.
After each training step, a return gate determines which synthesized role specifications enter the shared library.
